summary: Gridlock'd is a film set in Detroit about three heroin addicts: Spoon (Tupac Shakur), Stretch (Tim Roth) and Cookie (Thandie Newton). They form a spoken word band called Eight Mile Road. After Cookie overdoses on her first hit, Spoon and Stretch decide to kick their habit, but over one disastrous day they dodge police and local criminals while an apathetic government bureaucracy blocks their entry into a rehabilitation program.
one_line: Gridlock'd is a film about two heroin addicts in Detroit who try to get into rehab after a bandmate's overdose.
key_facts: The film centers on heroin addicts Spoon, Stretch and Cookie.
Spoon is played by Tupac Shakur.
Stretch is played by Tim Roth.
Cookie is played by Thandie Newton.
The three characters are in a spoken word band called Eight Mile Road.
Cookie sings vocals in Eight Mile Road.
Spoon plays bass guitar and provides secondary vocals in Eight Mile Road.
Stretch plays piano in Eight Mile Road.
Spoon and Stretch decide to kick their habit after Cookie overdoses on her first hit.
Over a disastrous day, the two addicts dodge police and local criminals.
The addicts struggle with an apathetic government bureaucracy that thwarts their entrance to a rehabilitation program.
